position_parameterization: 69 current candidate parameters: 16 diagonal distribution offsets, 32 normalized response coordinates, 21 query-independent response-gate weights; base diagonal network frozen
position_validation_selection: minimum equally weighted alive diagonal and alive off-diagonal emitted-XY full energy-score U-statistic; earliest step breaks ties
head_parameterization: all 1569 parameters of the existing 14-32-32-1 tanh MLP, initialized from the corresponding frozen old head
head_validation_selection: minimum equal-weight BCE across nonempty actual-hazard landing groups defined by current left approach, current inside hazard, and other current position; earliest step breaks ties
optimizer_state: reset to zero for both repairs; initialization weights retained
hazard_support_rule: all old and repaired heads are multiplied by the native hazardous-landing indicator at inference and training; probability is exactly zero otherwise

practical_acceptance.head: in both seeds, lower final actual-successor Brier and absolute calibration bias overall and on actual hazardous landings
practical_acceptance.position: in both seeds, lower final alive diagonal/off-diagonal energy score and lower absolute current-hazard residence error and horizontal-displacement residual, without worsening hazard-entry absolute error by more than 0.03
practical_acceptance.combined: in both seeds, improve absolute native gaps in reward occurrence and failure probability versus supported old/old while retaining the matched component improvements; mean return alone cannot pass

selection: one architecture and schedule, validation-only checkpoint selection, no extension or final-evaluation tuning
